text: You are going to investigate the reaction between dilute hydrochloric acid and two different aqueous
solutions of sodium hydroxide labelled solution O and solution P.
Read all the instructions carefully before starting the experiments.
You are going to carry out two experiments.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Describe the appearance of solid Q.

Add about 10cm of distilled water to all of solid Q in the test-tube and shake to dissolve the solid.
Divide the solution into three equal portions in three test-tubes and carry out the following tests.

parts.label: (i)
parts.text:
To the first portion of the solution, add drops of aqueous sodium hydroxide until a change
is seen.
Record your observations.

parts.label: (ii)
parts.text:
Now add an excess of aqueous sodium hydroxide to the mixture.
Record your observations.

parts.label: (i)
parts.text:
To the second portion of the solution, add drops of aqueous ammonia until a change is
seen.
Record your observations.

parts.label: (ii)
parts.text:
Now add an excess of aqueous ammonia to the mixture.
Record your observations.

parts.label: (d)
parts.text:
To the third portion of the solution, add a few drops of dilute nitric acid and about 1cm of
aqueous silver nitrate.
Record your observations.

Keep your mixture from test (d) to compare the result with test (h).

parts.label: (e)
parts.text:
Identify solid Q.

tests on solid R

parts.label: (f)
parts.text:
Carry out a flame test on solid R.
Record your observations.

Dissolve the rest of solid R in about 5cm of distilled water in a test-tube. Shake the mixture to
dissolve the solid. Divide the solution into two equal portions in two test-tubes.

parts.label: (g)
parts.text:
To the first portion of the solution, add a few drops of dilute nitric acid and about 1cm of
aqueous barium nitrate.
Record your observations.

parts.label: (h)
parts.text:
To the second portion of the solution, add a few drops of dilute nitric acid and about 1cm of
aqueous silver nitrate.
Compare the result with test (d). Record your observations for test (h).
